note: Myanmar: Singapore's citizens enter without a visa for 30 days; Russia's, Belarus's and Vietnam's for 30 days and the rest of ASEAN's (Malaysia's since 1 October 2025) for 14, for tourism through the Yangon, Nay Pyi Taw or Mandalay airports. China, Hong Kong and India take a visa on arrival (30 days; Japan's, Macao's and Korea's arrangement ran to 21 October 2026 and has lapsed). The citizens of the 100 countries the Ministry of Immigration and Population lists, and of Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao, may apply for a tourist e-Visa online (a stay of up to 28 days); everyone else needs a visa from a mission. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Ministry's own eVisa notice, which gives the e-Visa's list and its 28 days and corrected the file, which had held the e-Visa open to every other passport; its exemption list, dated 1 September 2022, predates the exemptions for Russia, Belarus and Malaysia that Wikipedia's copy records, so those are kept from Wikipedia, as are the visas on arrival, which the notice doesn't give.
